newsitem.title: INDIA: RESEARCH ALERT-MERRILL LYNCH UPGRADES ENGINEERING.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-MERRILL LYNCH UPGRADES ENGINEERING.

text.p: Investment bank Merrill Lynch said on Wednesday it was upgrading India's engineering and finance sectors to overweight from neutral because of improved prospects.
It also forecast the 30-share Bombay Stock Exchange index at 4,500 by September, falling in the last quarter to 4,250 by December.
"We believe falling interest rates and increasing liquidity are driving the market in the short term," Merrill Lynch said in its latest strategy report.
"However, worries on interim results accompanied by earnings downgrades and increased stock supply .. are expected to lead to a downward correction," it said.

Two global depositary receipt issues planned by state-run Gas Authority of India and Mahanagar Telecom Nigam Ltd totalling about $1.5 billion would feed into foreign demand for Indian stocks, it said.
The U.S. investment bank said the report was compiled along with its Indian affiliate DSP Merrill Lynch.
It expects an awaited economic recovery to start by November and advised investors to shuffle their portfolios.
"We believe investors should gradually shift their portfolios to sectors which will benefit from the economy recovery," said Jyotivardhan Jaipuria, first vice president, DSP Merrill Lynch.
"We're therefore upgrading the engineering sector to overweight (recommended stock: Larsen & Toubro ) and the cement sector neutral (recommended stock: India Cements )," he said.
"We are upgrading the finance sector to overweight based on our more positive stance on the development of financial institutions," he added.
